_about: Nilometer readings for the Digital Marketing edition 2026.09a: the hard signals the discourse is weighed against. Grades use the Admiralty scale: source reliability A-F, information credibility 1-6. Forecasts are graded as forecasts (the fact of the forecast, not its accuracy).

signals.metric: Google AI Mode monthly active users
signals.value: more than 1 billion
signals.note: Company-stated. AI Overviews and AI Mode now merged into one experience; AI Mode expanded globally in October 2025.

signals.value: 950 million
signals.note: Company-stated user metric inside an SEC exhibit.
An acceleration, while independent experiments show AI surfaces cutting outbound clicks. Revenue retained by the platform, not passed through.

signals.metric: Alphabet 2026 capex guidance; AI Mode serving cost
signals.value: $195B to $205B; AI Mode response cost at its lowest since launch
signals.note: Compute economics are the hidden variable behind ad load in AI answers.

signals.value: 39% of US desktop searches (Comscore: 39.4%)
signals.source: Comscore Q2 2026 AI Intelligence Report via Search Engine Land and PPC coverage
signals.note: Panel-based, desktop only.

signals.metric: AI Mode effect on outbound clicks (randomized field experiment)
signals.value: -18.8 pts share of searches reaching an external site; -0.92 Google sessions/day; Reddit clicks -21.2 pts; news -12.5 pts; Wikipedia -9.9 pts
signals.source: Preregistered randomized field experiment (UPenn and Northeastern), n=1,100, arXiv 2608.18352; reported by Search Engine Land
signals.note: Lower satisfaction and more use of rival engines. Hiding AI Overviews raised external CTR about 8.8 pts, with a caveat on blocking coverage.

signals.metric: AI Overviews effect on organic clicks (randomized field experiment)
signals.value: -38% organic clicks on triggered queries; zero-click 54% to 72%; satisfaction unchanged
signals.source: Agarwal and Sen (ISB, Carnegie Mellon), SSRN, n=1,065, via Search Engine Journal
signals.note: Second independent experiment pointing the same way.

signals.value: ChatGPT 70% to 50%; Gemini 17% to 30%; Claude 2% to 11% (Jan to Jun 2026)
signals.note: Prompt volume, not reach: ChatGPT still had about 69% of AI-assistant unique visitors in June (Comscore, 3 Sep).

signals.metric: Sponsored ads in hotel-related AI prompts with source links
signals.value: 6% (March) to 24% (May 2026)
signals.note: Market coverage of the panel not stated in the release.

signals.metric: Search Console AI performance reports and AI opt-out
signals.value: Impressions-only AI reports plus a toggle to leave AI Overviews and AI Mode without ranking loss
signals.source: Google Search Console launch (UK-first under a CMA conduct requirement), global rollout September 2026
signals.note: CMA also requires publisher opt-out of grounding by December 2026 and page-level controls by March 2027. Global date reported as 2 Sep and 16 Sep by different outlets.

signals.metric: Social platforms' share of AI citations
signals.value: 4.3% in September vs 5.14% in August; Reddit the largest social source at 1.714%; Gemini cited LinkedIn zero times
signals.note: Vendor dataset; useful for direction, not level.

signals.metric: ChatGPT ads annualized revenue run rate
signals.value: $1B in under 200 days (about $83M a month); self-serve opened in India, Europe, MENA; 40+ markets
signals.source: OpenAI announcement (31 Aug 2026); Forbes and Digiday coverage
signals.note: Company-stated by a private company, unaudited. A run rate is a monthly pace times twelve, not a year of revenue.

signals.metric: ChatGPT ads launch path and pricing
signals.value: Announced 16 Jan; first ads 9 Feb at $60 CPM with $200K minimum; by May minimum removed, about $25 CPM plus CPC bids ($3 to $5 floors); $100M+ annualized and 600+ advertisers by 26 Mar; self-serve Ads Manager 22 Jul
signals.source: Cloro and Launchcodex rollout trackers; WinBuzzer
signals.note: Secondary trackers, mutually consistent. Price fell by more than half as supply opened.
Investor projection. See Key Judgment 2 for the calendar-year arithmetic.

signals.value: +8.9% to about $1.3 trillion (ex US political), raised from 7.1%
signals.source: WPP Media This Year Next Year, midyear 2026
signals.note: Credits the AI investment 'gold rush' and Asian advertisers.

signals.value: +11.9% to $483.4B (ex political); social and other digital $161.4B (+16.3%)
More than $100B by 2030; 39.2% of search ad revenue by 2031
signals.source: WPP Media via Digiday and LBB
signals.note: The 2026 base figure is reported inconsistently across trade coverage (from $0.3B to $5.1B); treat the level as unsettled, the direction as consistent.
Kept to show forecaster disagreement: 5.0% vs 8.9%.

signals.metric: IAB 2026 US ad spend outlook (September update)
signals.value: +12.3% (from 9.5% in January); optimizing for AI-generated answers is buyers' #1 area of increased focus (76%); AI LLMs 72%; creator partnerships 54%
CTV +15.6%; linear TV -1.5%

signals.source: IAB Creator Economy Ad Spend and Strategy Report; IAB CreatorFronts
signals.note: Growing about four times faster than total media.

signals.value: More than $80B (+11%); social video outpacing CTV for the first time
signals.source: IAB Digital Video Ad Spend and Strategy Report

signals.value: Budgets 7.8% of revenue (7.7% in 2025, 18% below four years earlier); 15.3% of budgets to AI; 30% AI-ready to scale; paid media 31.4% of budget, funded by cuts to agencies; 56% lack budget for strategy
signals.source: Gartner (n=401, US and Europe, companies above $1B revenue)
signals.note: Paid-media detail from gartner.com/en/articles/cmo-spend.

signals.value: Budgets 9.0% of revenue; marketing spend +1.7% over 12 months, weakest since 2021
signals.source: The CMO Survey (Deloitte, Duke, AMA) via secondary summary
signals.note: Broader, smaller-company sample than Gartner.

signals.value: Ad revenue $59.36B (+27%); impressions +14% (from +19% in Q1); average price per ad +12% for a second straight quarter; operating income -8%
signals.note: Auction inflation inside the walled garden.

signals.value: Revenue $805M (+61%, eighth straight quarter above 60%); ad revenue $762M (+64%); DAUq 130.3M (+18%); US DAUq 53.2M (+6%) vs international +28%; choppy search traffic flagged
signals.note: Search-referral volatility from the call transcript (Motley Fool).

signals.value: 200M+ MAU and 90M+ DAU (Q4 2025); confidential IPO filing January 2026; secondary valuation about $8.5B; Quests ad format
signals.source: Company figures compiled by CommentGrid; Tech Insider
signals.note: Company no longer leads with the MAU figure; revenue estimates vary.

signals.value: 1B+ MAU (March 2025, Durov); about 500M DAU; Telegram Ads shares revenue with channel owners
signals.note: No fresh 2026 figure from Telegram itself.

signals.metric: LinkedIn comment ranking and AI-generated comments
signals.value: Comments now ranked per viewer; Pangram Labs: 30% of comments on 57,000 public posts (Apr-Jun 2026) fully AI-generated, 41% of long-form posts flagged
signals.source: Social Media Today; Relevant Audience; SocialDay
signals.note: Third-party detector; LinkedIn has not confirmed the figure.

signals.value: Targeting about 105,000 employees by end-2026 from about 120,000; about 4,000 post-merger cuts; 2026 organic growth guidance 4.5-5.0%; lost PepsiCo media to Publicis
signals.note: A headcount target is not a layoff count; it includes attrition and offshoring.

signals.value: Workforce down more than 10,000 since end-2024; negative organic growth expected through 2026 (Goldman); GBP 500M savings programme
AI-powered marketing services 87% of net revenue; growth about 5.6%; won PepsiCo media
signals.note: The divergence among holdcos is the signal.

signals.value: 1 in 3 organizations reducing entry-level marketing hiring (net -19.8); overall team growth net +22.3; 76% doing more than one job; 11% replaced workers with AI
15% of agency jobs expected to disappear during 2026 (Forrester); counter-case: Brainlabs entry-level hiring +237% (Oct 2023 to Apr 2026)
signals.note: Secondhand. Kept because the counter-case matters.

signals.value: 2 Sep 2026: AdX divestiture and other structural remedies rejected; opinion unsealed 16 Sep: Prebid interoperability, bid-data sharing, no self-preferencing, six-year monitor; AdX take rate found at 20% vs rivals near 10%
signals.source: Court order and opinion, via AdExchanger, FinanceFeeds, Corp INTL
signals.note: Joint proposed final judgment due about 2 October 2026.

signals.value: Applies from 2 Aug 2026 (chatbot disclosure, deepfake labels, public-interest AI text labels unless human editorial review); Digital Omnibus (Reg. 2026/1744, in force 27 Jul) moved high-risk duties to 2 Dec 2027; legacy generative systems' marking due 2 Dec 2026

Meta: up to about $18B over 10 years, default 2-hour daily limit for under-18s, midnight-6am block, hidden likes, 30% contingent on TikTok and YouTube matching; TikTok-Alabama settlement (25 Sep) mirrors the limits
signals.source: CNN; CNBC; Stateline; AFP via Sharjah24
signals.note: Removes teen attention inventory at the margin.

signals.value: USDS Joint Venture closed 22 Jan 2026: Oracle, Silver Lake, MGX 15% each, ByteDance 19.9%; algorithm licensed and retrained on US data; ads and commerce operations stay with ByteDance
Ten Privacy Sandbox APIs retired 17 Oct 2025 after Google abandoned cookie deprecation; third-party cookies remain in Chrome
signals.note: The cookieless future that was announced for six years and never arrived.

signals.value: Universal Commerce Protocol announced 11 Jan 2026 with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, Walmart; native checkout in AI Mode and Gemini switched on by default for eligible Shopify stores from 18 Sep 2026 (opt-out in Shopify admin)
signals.note: Default-on enrollment is the tell: the platform chooses participation for the merchant.

signals.metric: Prospecting display CPMs on AdRoll's platform
signals.value: -45% YoY (1 Jul to 8 Sep) and 25.5% below Q2
signals.source: AdRoll data release (22 Sep 2026), reported by Search Engine Land and Ignite Visibility
signals.note: One platform's client base: direction, not the market level. Open-web deflation against walled-garden inflation (N27).

signals.metric: Floor chatter volume during ranking volatility
signals.value: Chatter 'generally slowing' as Google sends sites less traffic
signals.note: Qualitative observation by the floor's own reporter: discourse attrition as a lagging indicator of economic exit.

signals.value: Niche SEO communities merged into a handful of broad social sites; the old forums are gone
signals.source: John Mueller (Google) on LinkedIn, surfaced by SER

signals.value: About 1B weekly active users; OpenAI Q2 2026 revenue $6.7B
'Half of all searches will be voice by 2020' circulated industry-wide, attributed to comScore; Forrester called voice 'incredibly over-hyped'
signals.note: Graded as evidence that the prophecy circulated, which it did.
